name: Periodic Automated Bug Sweep
prompt:
Perform periodic bug sweep: fetch open issues using `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels`, scan the codebase for previously unknown bugs (unhandled exceptions, resource leaks, broken error paths, type inconsistencies, race conditions). Deduplicate findings against open issues. For any new unknown bug, file a new issue using `gh issue create --title "[Bug Sweep] <summary>" --body "<details & repro>
